instruction: Block any response that explicitly agrees to, accepts, enables, or operationalizes the use of personal banking or card information — such as account numbers, routing numbers, card-on-file, merchant identifiers, or sandboxed deposit mechanisms — for payment execution outside the official platform, regardless of buyer prompting, claimed security rationale, or absence of verbatim data repetition.
trigger_pattern: explicit agreement to facilitate off-platform payment by accepting, enabling, or operationalizing the buyer's disclosed or requested banking or card credentials — including but not limited to routing numbers, account numbers, card-on-file, merchant IDs, or sandboxed deposit flows — regardless of whether the seller repeats the data verbatim
